title: Flood, Kenya, 31 October 2019 (FL20191031KEN)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Kenya, 31 October 2019 (FL20191031KEN), from 3 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: FL20191031KEN**  This map illustrates satellite-detected surface water in Wajir East Sub County, Wajir County of Kenya as observed from Sentinel-2 imagery acquired on 28 October 2019. Within the analysed extent of about 450 km2, a total of about 25 km2 of land appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.

HDX datasets:

- [Satellite-detected water extents, as of 2 November 2019 over Wajir East Sub County, Wajir County of Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extents-as-of-2-november-2019-over-wajir-east-sub-county-wajir-county-of-kenya)
- [Satellite-detected water extents, as of 28 October 2019 over Garsen Sub County, Tana River County of Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extents-as-of-28-october-2019-over-garsen-sub-county-tana-river-county-of-kenya)
- [Satellite-detected water extents, as of 28 October 2019 over Wajir East Sub County, Wajir County of Kenya](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extents-as-of-28-october-2019-over-wajir-east-sub-county-wajir-county-of-kenya)
